c17_authority.note: C17-approved finite-area formulation: patch points x_i with area-quadrature weights w_i (sum 1), bone state (c, R), bone-local anchors a_i, energy Pi = 1/2 sum w_i e_i^T W e_i, Kbar = kappa_areal * A_patch; rotational block about the anchor centroid M = sum_i w_i [a~_i]_x^T Kbar [a~_i]_x; admission accepts iff lambda_min(M) >= k_couple_min where k_couple_min is an AUTHORED requirement unless independently sourced; isotropic scalar k must equal kappa_areal*A_patch within 1e-3 relative (consistent provenance never admits by itself). The synthetic lambda_min = 32 N*m/rad demo result does NOT transfer (C17 verification clause). This module re-implements the closed-form block and the gate; it does not import the untracked reference.
